test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Honest and polite people are admired by everyone.

options.text: Everyone has been admiring honest and polite people.
Everyone admired honest and polite people.
Everyone will admire honest and polite people.
Everyone admires honest and polite people.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Everyone admires honest and polite people."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
